title: Evidence at Human Scale: contract definitions C01–C07
description: Documentation-only contracts C01–C07 for a reference architecture. One assistant means one interaction contract, which does not require one model, one runtime or one failure domain. Not a deployment, application or customer solution.

context.title: C01 Context
context.description: Documentation-only contract C01 Context. Structural validity is not truth, effective authorization or workflow safety.

evidence.title: C02 Evidence
evidence.description: Documentation-only contract C02 Evidence. Structural validity is not truth, effective authorization or workflow safety.

payload_reference.description: Explicit payload location or pointer. No claim_id is permitted on a payload-only reference.

uncertainty.description: Domain-defined uncertainty state and attributable basis; no unsupported probability.

coverage.description: Complete applies only to declared assessed scope, never implicitly to an entire corpus.

relationship.description: Derivation ancestry must be acyclic; contradiction/supersession/validation/invalidation are non-ancestry annotations. Type vocabulary is domain-registered, not a new universal policy.

conflict.description: References must identify genuinely conflicting assertions under the declared scope; external oracle checks materiality and preservation.

obligation.description: Acknowledgement is not resolution; domain policies define states, priorities and escalation.

named_parameter.description: Closed typed scalar or compound parameter representation. Objects use arrays of named typed members; arrays use typed elements. No open authority metadata.

parameter_constraint.description: Typed parameter constraint expression is interpreted by the referenced domain policy, not arbitrary authority metadata.

atomic_accounting.description: For unsupported shared atomic enforcement, unattended operation must be disabled beyond documented domain acceptance. Atomic assertions are structural declarations, not executed concurrency guarantees.

oneOf.description: Expected input not obtained (reason may be unknown).
Completed scoped retrieval returned no relevant record; not evidence of absence.
Current principal may know the input exists but may not read it; shown only in the wording the permission decision allows.
Source/dependency could not provide data, distinct from permission denial.
Explicit adequately scoped observation reports absence with method/time/coverage.
Check or assessment of the input was not performed. Not the evaluation status NOT ASSESSED.
Available record fails applicable freshness requirement.

typed_payload.description: Explicit typed content extension boundary. The referenced payload schema must be resolved and validated separately; content cannot alter authority metadata. Only value objects may carry arbitrary payload keys.

canonical_missingness_definitions.missing: Expected input not obtained (reason may be unknown).
canonical_missingness_definitions.not_retrieved: Completed scoped retrieval returned no relevant record; not evidence of absence.
canonical_missingness_definitions.inaccessible: Current principal may know the input exists but may not read it; shown only in the wording the permission decision allows.
canonical_missingness_definitions.unavailable: Source/dependency could not provide data, distinct from permission denial.
canonical_missingness_definitions.negative: Explicit adequately scoped observation reports absence with method/time/coverage.
canonical_missingness_definitions.not_assessed: Check or assessment of the input was not performed. Not the evaluation status NOT ASSESSED.
canonical_missingness_definitions.stale: Available record fails applicable freshness requirement.

reference_metadata.verification_method: Official specification pages read on the verification date
reference_metadata.verification_qualification: Format assertions must be configured; structural validity does not independently establish truth, authority or workflow safety

passage.summary: Version identity and canonical specification sources
Includes format annotation, not automatic format assertion
Only present assertions affect instance validation; dialect identification
Encoded constraints/format checks cannot verify source existence or execution safety

representation_notes: The specification fixes groups/cardinalities/semantics but not every nested field spelling. Snake_case names and explicit discriminators render those semantics; domain status/risk/materiality/policy vocabularies remain nonempty strings, not newly invented universal enums.

contract_id and schema_version are required at each contract root; identity groups contain instance ID/version. schema_version remains a nonempty string because the specification prescribes no fixed instance schema_version value.
Coverage prose complete/partial/not-assessed is rendered complete/partial/not_assessed, consistent with canonical underscore notation.

Generic exact contract references contain contract_id, id and version; supporting evidence references contain record_id, version, tagged claim/payload identity, original locator, scope and evidence_kind.

Typed payload value is the sole open content extension boundary. Resolve referenced payload schema and validate its domain content externally. Action parameters use closed typed named scalar or compound representations. Compound objects are arrays of named typed members; arrays contain typed elements. Domain constraints are externally evaluated; no arbitrary authority keys are allowed.
No structural declaration establishes shared atomic enforcement, source truth, effective authorization, independently corroborated evidence, or exactly-once business effects.
Unknown and partial receipts remain unresolved states. A reconciled terminal outcome uses a revised receipt/version, subject to an external workflow oracle.
external_checks: Exact reference existence/version/uniqueness and original-source/payload-pointer resolution
Registered producer/permitted kinds and applicable method versions
Acyclic derivation and shared-root independence analysis
Current tenant/principal/purpose/disclosure/permission/freshness checks on release, every view and cache/historical serve
Approval or grant authenticity, exact binding, expiry/revocation and commit-time evidence/policy/target-state checks
Shared atomic consumed/reserved grant limits across concurrent execution, conservative unknown accounting, authoritative reconciliation and partial-effect charging
External target race/idempotency/weaker guarantee/domain acceptance verification; no unattended operations beyond acceptance
Authoritative outcome verification and no-effect truth; timeout/lease expiry cannot establish absence of effects
Workflow transitions, notifications/recovery/compensation/retention/invalidation and all architectural EV01–EV12 fixtures are NOT ASSESSED
